summary: Frontend changes show a new backend-driven location autocomplete hook and updated PropertySearchBar behavior (suggestions dropdown + keyboard handling). The backend diff is truncated and does not provide visible evidence of the required public autocomplete query implementation (dedupe/case-insensitive match against both title and location, default maxResults=10). Also, the diff summary does not provide explicit evidence that any existing Google Places Autocomplete loading/querying has been removed/disabled across the public search typeahead.

missing_requirements.requirement: Backend query for listing-based autocomplete suggestions returns a deduplicated, case-insensitive matched list derived from BOTH property.location and property.title, and respects maxResults (default 10 when null); publicly accessible and does not trap for unauthenticated callers.

evidence: backend/main.mo (truncated; no visible autocomplete query implementation)

missing_requirements.requirement: Frontend does not attempt to load or query Google Places Autocomplete for the public search location typeahead (even if VITE_GOOGLE_PLACES_API_KEY is present).
missing_requirements.reason: While PropertySearchBar now uses a backend-based suggestions hook, the diff summary does not include evidence that any prior Google Places Autocomplete integration (script loading, API calls, or components) has been removed/disabled elsewhere in the codebase.
evidence: frontend/src/components/search/PropertySearchBar.tsx (shows backend suggestions usage but not proof of removal of any Google Places code elsewhere)
